unmapped_field_notes.DestinationHostname: destination hostname is not captured on NetworkInfo
unmapped_field_notes.Hashes: Sigma matches Sysmon's combined 'SHA1=..,MD5=..,IMPHASH=..' string (often IMPHASH, which no adapter captures); no exact mapping onto structured hashes
unmapped_field_notes.Initiated: Sysmon 'Initiated' → ECS network.direction mapping is not verified
unmapped_field_notes.ParentUser: the parent process's user is not captured
unmapped_field_notes.SourceCommandLine: Sysmon 8 carries no source command line
unmapped_field_notes.SourceUser: the acting process's user is not captured for process access
unmapped_field_notes.User: UserRef splits domain and name; Sigma matches the combined 'DOMAIN\user' string
